subject: CentraBank MAP: security evidence intake & target close
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@centrabank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: CentraBank MAP: security evidence intake & target close

Hi Alice — thanks again for the call today. Quick post-call recap and a proposal for the MAP milestone focused on security review / SOC 2 package delivery so your security and procurement teams have a clear set of asks and dates. Attached is a first-pass worksheet (CentraBank_MAP_v1.xlsx) with milestone ownership and dependencies.

High-level proposal (security milestone):
- Milestone name: Security review & SOC 2 evidence delivery
- Target completion: 2027-03-25 (aligned to your onboarding window)
- Redwood owner: Olga Petrov (Account lead) & Grace O'Connor (Customer Success)
- CentraBank owner: Alice Chen (Security reviewer) & Marcus Bell (Procurement)
- Deliverables from Redwood: SOC 2 summary, control narratives, evidence index, sample logs (redwood_soc2-evidence-index.pdf)
- Dependencies: CentraBank access to shared Drive + security intake questionnaire completion by 2027-03-11
- Acceptance criteria: CentraBank confirms evidence set meets internal intake checklist and there are no outstanding blockers for procurement to finalize terms.

Next actions I propose:
1) Alice/Marcus: confirm the intake questionnaire owner and whether CentraBank requires any additional artifacts beyond the index (due: 2027-03-11).
2) Redwood (Olga/Grace): upload SOC 2 materials and a one-page control summary to Drive and share link (today/Tomorrow).
3) Technical follow-up (Aditya): schedule a 30-min deep dive for Marcus/security engineer if they want log-level samples or architecture details (recommend week of Mar 15).

Please let us know if the 3/25 completion target is realistic for your timeline; we can tighten or extend the dates based on procurement windows.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: CentraBank_MAP_v1.xlsx)

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@centrabank.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Bell <marcus.bell@centrabank.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: CentraBank MAP: security evidence intake & target close

Thanks, Olga — good summary. A few quick clarifying questions from our side: 

- Can you confirm exactly which artifacts will be in the SOC 2 evidence index? (we need to show this to our auditors)
- Our security intake owner is Marcus Bell (copied). If Marcus confirms, we'll assign a point person for the questionnaire — likely Jane Park from InfoSec. Is 3/11 realistic for completion of the questionnaire on our side?
- We have an internal vendor onboarding target to cut PO and complete vendor checks by 2027-04-15. Can we make 3/25 work to leave buffer for procurement?

Also, please include a redacted example of any logs or retention summaries you provide — our team needs to validate retention and access controls.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alice Chen
Senior Security Analyst, CentraBank
alice.chen@centrabank.com
(Internal: we may loop in Jane and Procurement after Olga confirms artifacts)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@centrabank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 11:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CentraBank MAP: security evidence intake & target close

Thanks Alice — answers inline and a slightly-expanded milestone table below. I also uploaded a short index (redwood_soc2-evidence-index.pdf) to the Drive link and attached it here for convenience.

Q: Which artifacts?
A: The evidence index includes: SOC 2 Type II report summary (redacted where necessary), control narratives (authentication, data access, change management), encryption at-rest/in-transit descriptions, sample logs (redacted), retention policy, and contact points for audit requests. If Jane needs additional raw artifacts we can coordinate a controlled share.

Q: Questionnaire timeline
A: 3/11 is reasonable if Jane can take the lead; we can provide a pre-filled section that answers standard ops/security questions to speed it up.

Q: 3/25 completion for procurement buffer
A: We can commit to 3/25 for the security evidence delivery and make ourselves available for any rapid follow-ups to keep Procurement on schedule for 4/15.

Proposed milestone table (one-line rows):
- Intake form completion — Owner (CentraBank: Jane Park) — Due 2027-03-11 — Dependency: internal reviewer assigned
- Redwood evidence upload — Owner (Redwood: Olga/Grace) — Due 2027-03-12 — Dependency: Drive access + NDA as required
- Security review meeting (30 min) — Owner (CentraBank: Marcus / Redwood: Aditya) — Target week of 2027-03-15 — Dependency: sample logs shared
- Evidence acceptance / sign-off — Owner (CentraBank: Alice) — Due 2027-03-25 — Acceptance criteria: evidence set meets checklist
- Procurement close / PO issuance — Owner (CentraBank: Marcus) — Target 2027-04-15 — Dependency: sign-off on evidence and commercial terms

Acceptance items we will provide in the upload: redwood_soc2-evidence-index.pdf (attached), one-page control summary, redacted log samples (S3 access logs), and a contact list for audit requests.

Would you like us to pre-populate the questionnaire and send a draft version to Jane? If so, we'll drop it in the Drive and flag any fields where CentraBank needs to fill proprietary details.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood_soc2-evidence-index.pdf; Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bCcentra-map)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@centrabank.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CentraBank MAP: security evidence intake & target close

Adding a quick procurement/ops note from the commercial side — cc'ing Alice so she's aware of the ask.

- Deal ID: RW-DB-8472. Current commercial terms are in HubSpot (link in thread). We have a standard SOC 2 evidence pack included in the enterprise onboarding bundle; there are no additional fees for sharing redacted evidence for security review.
- If CentraBank requires an in-person audit or full raw artifacts, that would be an out-of-scope activity; we'd handle via an SOW.
- To keep the 4/15 procurement target, I recommend we aim to have evidence accepted by 3/25 and a short commercial review (final T&Cs) completed by 4/01. That gives Procurement two weeks to issue PO.

I can own scheduling the technical deep-dive with Marcus and Jane — available Tue/Thu 10:00-12:00 PT the week of Mar 15.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
(Internal note: flag for potential SOW if they request raw audit access)

From: Marcus Bell <marcus.bell@centrabank.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@centrabank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: CentraBank MAP: security evidence intake & target close

Olga / team — thanks for the clear plan. Confirming the intake owner (Jane Park) will complete the questionnaire by 2027-03-11. We reviewed the index and the artifacts listed look sufficient for our initial review — redacted logs + control narratives should cover most items. We'll schedule the 30-min review for 2027-03-16 at 11:00 AM ET (Aditya, can you confirm?).

We will aim to provide acceptance / sign-off on evidence by 2027-03-25 which keeps Procurement on track to issue PO by 2027-04-15. If anything unexpected comes up during review we'll loop you in the same day.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Marcus Bell
Director, Vendor Risk & Procurement, CentraBank
marcus.bell@centrabank.com
